title: P6-01: Pre-flight: record decisions, save before-state and live baselines for both sites (read-only)
description:
## Goal
Pilobol.us has NEW CMS and reader apps and a fresh backend in papyrus-production (712236451410), domain-free, first CMS build green on its default amplifyapp.com URL, release gates passed. Legacy keeps serving everything.

## Context (FACT)
- Template stack name amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us-cms (a different account, so no collision). Legacy features all false (inbound email, storage backups, Slack, console responder): keep false.
- Cognito domain prefix `papyrus-pilobol-us-cms`: the legacy branch env var holds it but the live legacy pool vyTCcLVQK still uses the auto-generated domain 69a74c507e157f784c3c (no APPLY flag), and the name does not resolve in DNS, so it is free. Set `cms.cognitoDomainPrefix` AND `cms.applyCognitoDomainPrefix` true in the production copy of site.json, because the new pool is created fresh. Cognito domain prefixes are unique per region across all accounts; the assessment comment explains why legacy names cannot be reused.
- Lessons to apply (PPY-aa93b3, PPY-3367d3): console connect overwrites the branch env vars AND the app buildSpec and may flip the platform or service role (restore with `aws amplify update-app --build-spec` from `papyrus-infra print-buildspec`); AppSync can throttle (429) in this account: deploy ONE backend at a time, wait and clean up a stuck stack before retrying; the backup vault name bug is fixed from next.35 (backups stay false here); withPapyrus must transpile cyclotron (next.37).
- The repo AnthusAI/Pilobol.us is shared by the legacy and the new apps: a push builds both. Pin bumps are fine; do not merge changes that need legacy-only config.

## Exact steps
1. Make the out-of-repo domain-free site.json copy (remove hostedZoneId, domainName, staging domain fields; set the prefix pair above; keep the reader block; pin the P6-01 version). `npx papyrus-infra synth`; `cdk diff` against papyrus-production (expect create-only); assert no Domain, no legacy ARNs, no SES.
2. Ryan yes: `cdk deploy` the stack into papyrus-production. Record CmsAppId, ReaderAppId, authoring and CI role ARNs (names only).
3. Ryan, one console sitting in papyrus-production: authorize the Amplify GitHub App for the account on AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, connect the CMS app (WEB_COMPUTE) and the reader app (WEB) to main. Compare `get-app` and `list-branches` before and after; apply the documented repairs (buildSpec, platform, service role, env var names). Keep reader auto-build OFF until P6-04.
4. Start the CMS main job; wait for pipeline-deploy and the frontend build. If AppSync throttles, wait, clean up the stuck stack, retry.
5. Gates on the default URL: schema gate (Item/PublishedItem bodyMarkus, bodyIr, aliases), brand gate (PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND and NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND equal pilobol-us), probes: newsroom at /, /newsroom behaviour as legacy, missing path returns the custom 404, robots; Cognito pool domain equals papyrus-pilobol-us-cms.

## Acceptance checks
- get-app: WEB_COMPUTE (CMS) and WEB (reader), repository AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, template roles; branch main PRODUCTION with the env var NAMES from site.json; job SUCCEED; new AppSync API and pool exist; gates pass; legacy app list-branches and associations identical to the P6-01 baseline.

## Rollback
Delete the new stack and the nested backend stack in production (Ryan); nothing public depends on them.

## Risks
Console connect side effects; AppSync 429; GitHub App not authorized for the account (stack deploy succeeds but connect fails).

## Needs Ryan
SSO, deploy yes, console sitting.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under /Users/home/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
